Though this is enough to complete this quest, you might need more very soon...%n%n%nIf you have Silk Touch, you can harvest the full mushroom blocks directly!
한국어(Korean).Mix together some Mushrooms and Amber to: Mix together some Mushrooms and Amber to create some Hardened Amber Moosh!
한국어(Korean).No it's not. But find some Amber scatter: No it's not. But find some Amber scattered around in Erebus and mine it up!
한국어(Korean).Please read the Melee Artifact quest des: Please read the Melee Artifact quest description. This quest is for Ranged Artifacts!
한국어(Korean).Once you've defeated all the Umbergolems: Once you've defeated all the Umbergolems, find your way back to the center and activate the Capstones on top by placing one of each Umbergolem Scarab into its Capstone! Then this quest will serve as a checklist on what you'll need. Near the entrance you'll find a chest that contains 8 Jades. Place them into the floor tiles to activate the trapdoor! You'll need to do this 4 more times with the items listed in this quest.%n%nNote: You can obtain Magma Cream from Fire Ants spawning in Erebus. The other items should be self-explanatory. You should have already gotten Exoskeleton Plates from Beetles roaming the Maze and Magma Crawler Eyes from Magma Crawlers commonly found on the ceiling of Maze corridors.
한국어(Korean).Find an Antlion Overlord Pyramid partial: Find an Antlion Overlord Pyramid partially (or sometimes fully) hidden underground exclusively in Volcanic Desert biomes! Descend into the Maze surrounding the Pyramid, and find the four Umbergolem Idol Guardians found in the farthest edges of the Maze! This quest is specifically for the Mud Umbergolem, found in the North-Western corner. Once defeated, pickup the Scarab they drop!
한국어(Korean).Please read the quest description of the: Please read the quest description of the Mud Umbergolem quest! The Gold Umbergolem is found in the South-Eastern corner of the Maze.
한국어(Korean).Brrr.... Freezing cold Winter! Finish up: Brrr.... Freezing cold Winter! Finish up Atum by crafting an Atum Warrior that lets you enter Iceika, the land of Winter!
한국어(Korean).Trade with Sunspeakers all the way until: Trade with Sunspeakers all the way until you get the Enchanted Golden Date trade! This item grants the exact same effect as an Enchanted Golden Apple. Though you might not want to eat it, and just keep it for progression.%nIf you don't want to or can't get the trade to show up, you can also find this rarely in any Crate in Atum.%nAdditionally, if you progress through Erebus and into The Aether, you can enchant a normal Golden Date into an Enchanted Golden Date. Yay choices!
한국어(Korean).Please read the Melee Artifact quest des: Please read the Melee Artifact quest description. This quest is for Armor Artifacts!
한국어(Korean).Craft a Crown of Skies that lets you ent: Craft a Crown of Skies that lets you enter the Aether!
한국어(Korean).Find some Mummies in Atum! They can spaw: Find some Mummies in Atum! They can spawn at night or in Pyramids. Defeat them and collect their Cloth Scraps!
한국어(Korean).Obtain some Flax Seeds by either finding: Obtain some Flax Seeds by either finding an Oasis and breaking the tall grass there, or finding some in a treasure chest!
한국어(Korean).Okay this block is ridiculous. This time: Okay this block is ridiculous. This time it speeds up any entity to 10x base walking speed. It works even better for a mob farm.%n%nOh, and the same mobs drop Supernatural Velocity as well.%n%n§6Note:§r This is an extremely rare drop, and you may want to wait until the Powered Spawner is unlocked to pursue this.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Radiant Beacon! This block emits: Craft a Radiant Beacon! This block emits red light and is later used as an ingredient for an actual Beacon.
한국어(Korean).Combine some Skyroot Remedy, Aechor Peta: Combine some Skyroot Remedy, Aechor Petal, Enchanted Gravitite, Aerogel & some Purple Dye to create this gooey material...
한국어(Korean).Once you've emptied an Aechor Plant, def: Once you've emptied an Aechor Plant, defeat it for its drop, the Aechor Petal!
한국어(Korean).Enchant your Skyroot Poison Bucket into: Enchant your Skyroot Poison Bucket into a Skyroot Remedy Bucket! You can drink this to clear any Poison effect from yourself, or use it for crafting.%n%nNote that it might take multiple Ambrosium Shards to fully craft this, so just keep a stack of them in the fuel slot.
한국어(Korean).Place some Lava in the Aether! It'll imm: Place some Lava in the Aether! It'll immediately freeze into Aerogel which you can mine up...%n%n§6Note:§r Later you'll need to automate this. You can use any fluid placer or a dispenser to automate it now, or later on you get access to mechanical users which can make Aerogel too.%n%n'Cause you're hot then you're cold,%nYou're yes then you're no,%nYou're in then you're out,%nYou're up then you're down,%nYou're wrong when it's right,%nIt's black and it's white,%nWe fight, we break up,%nTurn Lava to Ice!
한국어(Korean).Create some Enchanted Gravitite Blocks u: Create some Enchanted Gravitite Blocks using your Altar! Placing one of these blocks below the Altar will make it work twice as fast and use half as many Ambrosium Shards.
한국어(Korean).Find some Workshop Lamps spawning in sma: Find some Workshop Lamps spawning in small groups on some Coalstone Pillars!
한국어(Korean).Craft a Snow Globe to enter Iceika! Buil: Craft a Snow Globe to enter Iceika! Build a portal out of Snow Blocks in the shape of a regular Nether Portal (with a 2x3 inner area). Then light the portal with your Snow Globe!
한국어(Korean).Find some Aechor Plants that randomly sp: Find some Aechor Plants that randomly spawn on the surface of Aether islands! They have light cyan petals and usually spawn in small groups. Watch out, once you get close, they'll shoot poison darts at you. Once you get close, Right Click on them with your Skyroot Bucket to obtain Skyroot Poison. Each Plant can be Right Clicked on several times before they run out of Poison. Make sure to collect a lot of it.
한국어(Korean).Now that you have defeated all three Aet: Now that you have defeated all three Aether bosses, you can craft an Altar! Note that the Aether Power Core has 64 durability, so you can craft up to a stack of Enchanters. Just like the Freezer, this machine also accepts inputs pushed in through any side or the top, and you can pull out the result from the bottom. However, if you don't want to automate it yet, it might be smarter to put an Enchanted Gravitite Block below the machine. This way it'll work twice as fast and use half the Ambrosium Shards.
한국어(Korean).Though Draconium Ore is available in oth: Though Draconium Ore is available in other dimensions, it's in much greater quantity in the End. It can be found on the Main Island, Outer End Islands & End Comets. Mine up some of it!
한국어(Korean).Let the Eyes of Ender guide you to the E: Let the Eyes of Ender guide you to the End Portal! Activate it and enter it...%n%nThough I thought I didn't have to tell you this... Aren't you a professional Minecraft player?!%n%nThe rewarded bottles are to collect Dragon's Breath. Don't forget to nab some!
한국어(Korean).Slay some of the creatures in Iceika to: Slay some of the creatures in Iceika to obtain their precious Ice Shards!
한국어(Korean).Craft Steel or Golden Rings and Pendants: Craft Steel or Golden Rings and Pendants and turn them into Ice Rings and Pendants in your Freezer!
한국어(Korean).Craft an Aether Freezer! Fuel it with Ic: Craft an Aether Freezer! Fuel it with Icestone, and if you want to automate it, insert items from any side or top, and pull the result from the bottom using a Hopper!
한국어(Korean).After you've defeated the Ender Dragon,: After you've defeated the Ender Dragon, travel to the End Isles, find an End City, and loot the Elytra!
한국어(Korean).After you've defeated the Ender Drakyboo: After you've defeated the Ender Drakyboo, collect the Dragon Egg! What could be inside...!?
한국어(Korean).After entering the End, you might have n: After entering the End, you might have noticed this cute black drakyboo flapping around in the sky. Now, your job is to keep petting it until its Health Bar decreases to basically none and it releases cool shiny purple rays 'n stuff.%n%nThen collect its Dragon Heart. Easy peasy!
한국어(Korean).Craft a Gravitite or Valkyrie Axe and br: Craft a Gravitite or Valkyrie Axe and break some Golden Oak Tree logs to obtain some Golden Amber!%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%nIt's raining amber! Hallelujah!%nIt's raining amber! Amen!%nI'm gonna go out to run and let myself get%nAbsolutely soaking weeeeet!%n%nIt's raining amber! Hallelujah!%nIt's raining amber! Every specimen!%nTall, blonde, dark, and lean%nRough and tough and strong and meeeeaaaan!
한국어(Korean).Dig up some Zanite Gemstones, Ambrosium: Dig up some Zanite Gemstones, Ambrosium Shards, and Gravitite Ore from the Aether underground! Watch out for Gravitite Ores... they float.
한국어(Korean).Create some GP Powder from your Festive: Create some GP Powder from your Festive Powder, then duplicate it via crafting!%n%nYou can later automate the duplication recipe with a single RFTools Crafter. Setup 2 recipes for crafting GP Powder, one on Keep/Int, the other on Keep/ExtC. Fill the bottom two rows with the duplication ingredients, and leave 1 slot for GP Powder. Once all of these ingredients are in place, hit "R" to make the machine remember where the items should go. The slot with GP Powder will stay on 63 GP Powder at all times, and the rest will go in the output slot. Now you just need to pump in the ingredients and pump out the GP Powder (no need for a filter)!
한국어(Korean).The Santa Armor set is great and all, bu: The Santa Armor set is great and all, but Christmas time is nearing its end... But hey, maybe you can reuse your Santa gear for something else...?%n%nLook up the steps for crafting some Festive Powder in JEI, and create some!
한국어(Korean).Chop some Golden Oak or Skyroot Trees an: Chop some Golden Oak or Skyroot Trees and craft up some Skyroot Buckets!
한국어(Korean).Create a portal frame out of Glowstone B: Create a portal frame out of Glowstone Blocks with an inner area of 2x3 blocks (just like a simple Nether Portal), then activate it with a Water Bucket. To actually enter the Aether, you'll need to Right Click onto an Aether Portal block with the Crown of Skies. This will grant you access to the Aether forever, through any Aether portal.%n%nOnce you have entered the dimension, get your Book of Lore from the quest reward. This is a useful tool for checking what each Aether item and block does. Simply place the item/block inside the book to get a short description for it.%n%nFinally, don't worry about falling off an island - just like all other dimensions, you'll just wrap around and be teleported to the top of the world! If you have Slime Boots on, this shouldn't be an issue.
한국어(Korean).Find a dungeon underground in Iceika! Th: Find a dungeon underground in Iceika! They spawn quite commonly, uniformly on any height level. Consider using the Roots Augment Spell modified with Light Drifter to help you find a dungeon. Find a dungeon chest and loot some of the Snowflakes and Snowflake Shurikens that are inside. You can either use the Shurikens for damage or craft them into more Snowflakes!
한국어(Korean).Fold some Gold in the Enchanted Berries!: Fold some Gold in the Enchanted Berries! Unfortunately this will get rid of the great taste and make it inedible though...
한국어(Korean).Enchant some Blueberries in your Enchant: Enchant some Blueberries in your Enchanter. 100%% guaranteed better taste!
한국어(Korean).Craft a Portal to the Deep Dark! This is: Craft a Portal to the Deep Dark! This is a mining world, so it's the best place to set up your Quarry with some kind of item teleportation back to your base. You'll also need to send it power.%nBut make sure to bring torches or some kind of lighting, because the darkness inside the dimension will constantly damage you!
한국어(Korean).Create some Crystalline Pink Slime Ingot: Create some Crystalline Pink Slime Ingots then alloy it further into some Crystalline Brown Slime Ingots!
한국어(Korean).Mine up some Resonant End Stone to obtai: Mine up some Resonant End Stone to obtain Resonant Clathrate! This is used for Applied Energistics Fluid Storage Cells and Fluid-related items.
한국어(Korean).Travel to the End Islands and punch a Ch: Travel to the End Islands and punch a Chorus Plant to obtain a bunch of Chorus Fruit! Build yourself up higher to obtain some Chorus Flowers!
한국어(Korean).Combine Enchanted Golden Berries and Lea: Combine Enchanted Golden Berries and Lead Rods into Stems then ultimately a Necklace. Fancy!
한국어(Korean).Find a huge cathedral floating in the sk: Find a huge cathedral floating in the sky! This is the Silver Dungeon. Enter it and defeat at least 10 Valkyries. They'll each drop a Victory Medal. Then work your way to the final room, located on the opposite side of the main entrance. You'll find the Valkyrie Queen inside, who you can only challenge if you Right Click on her with 10 Victory Medals, to show that you are worthy to fight her.%n%nShe can teleport around and turn invisible during the fight, and send out area of effect orbs that damage the player. It's recommended to constantly push her away, or use building blocks to give you a temporary hiding place to heal up.%n%nWhen defeated, she'll drop a Silver Key. Using this you can unlock the Silver Treasure Chest to earn a Silver Aether Coin and a bunch of Valkyrie Metal.
한국어(Korean).Find some Blueberry Bushes! Break them t: Find some Blueberry Bushes! Break them to obtain their Berry. If you want to relocate them, break them again.
한국어(Korean).Brrr, it's cold, don't touch it: Brrr, it's cold, don't touch it
한국어(Korean).Find some Icestone underground in the Ae: Find some Icestone underground in the Aether! It's about as rare as Iron Ore in the overworld but spawns in larger veins.
한국어(Korean).It resonates with great power... THIS mu: It resonates with great power... THIS must be the source of energy...!
한국어(Korean).Enchant some Holystone to create some He: Enchant some Holystone to create some Healing Stones! They can be eaten to gain Regeneration I for half a minute. Or you can use them to progress further...
한국어(Korean).No need for Coal, it's built in!: No need for Coal, it's built in!
한국어(Korean).Obtain a Coalstone Furnace from Villager: Obtain a Coalstone Furnace from Villager houses in Iceika! Although these Furnaces cook slowly, they don't require any fuel to function.
한국어(Korean).Find an opening on the side of a larger: Find an opening on the side of a larger Aether island! You'll know if you've found a Bronze Dungeon, if the walls are made out of Carved Stone. Get to the end and awaken the Slider! This boss slides on walls and can only be damaged with a Pickaxe. Make sure to bring some Health Potions, Golden Apples, and good armor to the fight, because this boss can be pretty tough!%n%nOnce you've defeated the Slider, it'll drop a Bronze Key. Open the reward chest to find one Bronze Aether Coin inside!
한국어(Korean).During your Ender Dragon petting mission: During your Ender Dragon petting mission, collect some Dragon's Breath!%n%nIf you missed the opportunity to do so, you can resummon the Ender Dragon with 4 End Crystals on either side of the portal.%n%nIf you're having trouble collecting some because of Botania's Ender Air Bottles, try the following: Do NOT Right Click on blocks, instead, angle your clicks so you only reach the purple Dragon's Breath particles, and NOT the blocks below.
한국어(Korean).Find a smaller floating island covered w: Find a smaller floating island covered with Golden Oak Trees and the Gold Dungeon inside, with only one boss: the Sun Spirit. To initiate the fight, you'll need to talk to him several times... but you might want to prepare first.%n%nIf you've never done this fight before, this might take you a while, depending on how good your aim is. So prepare with multiple Fire Resistance and Healing Potions.%n%nFirstly, you cannot damage this boss with any regularly obtainable weapon or projectile, you can only damage it with projectiles called "Icey Balls" that randomly spawn from the Sun Spirit during the fight. However, both the boss and the iceballs randomly bounce around, which makes it hard to hit the iceballs into the Sun Spirit. Also, you can't wait too long, the iceballs will break a short time after spawning. Meanwhile, Fire Ball projectiles will also spawn and bounce around in the room. Make sure that neither the boss, nor the Fire Balls hit you. But especially watch out for the boss, as it deals a lot of damage on contact.%n%nYou'll need to hit iceballs into the Sun Spirit 10 times to defeat it. Once you've successfully done so, it'll drop a Golden Key. Open the Treasure Chest that appeared to obtain the Golden Aether Coin!
한국어(Korean).Obtain some Valkyrie Metal Ingots and Nu: Obtain some Valkyrie Metal Ingots and Nuggets from Silver Dungeon Chests!
한국어(Korean).Craft some Eyes of Ender in your Inducti: Craft some Eyes of Ender in your Induction Smelter. Use them to find the End Portal!%n%nThe End Exploration related quests are located in Exploration III.
한국어(Korean).Find a Village house in Iceika! Enter it: Find a Village house in Iceika! Enter it (you can open the Steel Door with a Right Click, no need to bust in by breaking it). Find the Workshop Merchant (red NPC) and trade some Snowflakes for the full set of Santa Armor!
한국어(Korean).Craft an Auto Enchantment Table! You can: Craft an Auto Enchantment Table! You can automatically insert tools, armor, or books inside to enchant them using liquid experience.
한국어(Korean).Craft some Open Ingots! These are used i: Craft some Open Ingots! These are used in a number of Open Blocks machines.
한국어(Korean).Craft an XP Bottler! This machine can fi: Craft an XP Bottler! This machine can fill up Empty Bottles with liquid experience pumped into it to create Bottles o' Enchanting. Everything can be automatically inserted and extracted.
한국어(Korean).Use materials from your Enchanter to cre: Use materials from your Enchanter to create a Sun Crystal! Throw it on the ground for a while to fill it up with sunlight. Later on, this can be done instantly via throwing it in EnderIO's Liquid Sunshine.
한국어(Korean).Craft some Unstable Ingots and upgrade t: Craft some Unstable Ingots and upgrade them immediately into some Moon Stones before they blow up! Make sure to have every material in your inventory, and do the second step of the crafting under 10 seconds, before the Unstable Ingots gets you.%n%nOr alternatively if you're rolling in Diamonds, you can spend 9 times the Diamond to craft Stable-'Unstable' Nuggets and put them together into a Stable-'Unstable' Ingot, which doesn't blow up, but can be used for crafting the same way.
한국어(Korean).Craft some Osglolapis and turn it into L: Craft some Osglolapis and turn it into Lunar Reactive Dust in your Resonator! This will require 16 GP total, meaning you'll need to use both the manual mill AND the Solar Panel, at least until you've gotten more GP Generators setup.
한국어(Korean).Craft some Stoneburnt in your Resonator!: Craft some Stoneburnt in your Resonator! Don't sniff it too much, it's got an awful smell...
한국어(Korean).Craft a Resonator! This is the most impo: Craft a Resonator! This is the most important Extra Utilities machine. You'll need GP Generating machines in order to use it. You might want to consider crafting multiple Resonators for automation.%n%nWhen playing in multiplayer, you can do §§§c/xu_powersharing§r to open a GUI. Click players on there to share GP with them, provided they would also share GP with you.
한국어(Korean).Craft an Absorption Hopper! This functio: Craft an Absorption Hopper! This functions very similarly to a Vacuum Hopper, except it can pull items through walls and with range upgrades it can have WAAAY more range!
한국어(Korean).Craft an Open Blocks Vacuum Hopper! This: Craft an Open Blocks Vacuum Hopper! This machine can suck up items and experience orbs from a range. You can also set output sides for each.
한국어(Korean).Alloy some Demonlord Ingots with some Gu: Alloy some Demonlord Ingots with some Gunpowder to obtain your first pieces of Mobgrindium Ingots! This is the gateway into Mob Grinding Utils.%n%nNote: If you're searching for Mob Grinding Utils in JEI, type @mob_grinding_utils.
한국어(Korean).An alternative way of moving mobs beside: An alternative way of moving mobs besides Fans are regular old Conveyor Belts! Mobs CAN spawn on these blocks, so if you want to, you can build your entire mob spawning platform out of these. However, I'd just use them sparingly since Cursed Earth and Mob Fans are way better.
한국어(Korean).\"Here is Goldey!\"%n%nUpgrade your Iron: "Here is Goldey!"%n%nUpgrade your Iron Spikes into Golden Ones. These might not deal as much damage, however anything killed by them drops experience!
한국어(Korean).Craft some Wooden, Stone, and finally Ir: Craft some Wooden, Stone, and finally Iron Spikes! This damages any mob standing on top or right besides it. Great for a mob farm!
한국어(Korean).Ever wanted your plants to grow faster?: Ever wanted your plants to grow faster? Introducing... the Imaginary Ti - I mean Hydrator Block! It tick accelerates nearby crops. Not as much as the Imaginary Time Block, but it's still pretty good. Without range upgrades it only speeds up itself, but toss in a range upgrade to make it affect blocks in a 5 block radius!
한국어(Korean).Use your Resonator to make some Red Coal: Use your Resonator to make some Red Coal, and then use it to craft a Redstone Star! The Red Coal will require 16 GP total, meaning you'll need to use both the manual mill AND the Solar Panel, at least until you've gotten more GP Generators setup.
한국어(Korean).Craft some Mob Masher Smite Upgrades. Yo: Craft some Mob Masher Smite Upgrades. You can insert at most 10 of these in the machine. This will make the Masher stronger against undead foes like Zombies and Skeletons.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Mob Masher! To activate it, use: Craft a Mob Masher! To activate it, use a redstone signal. This is a highly upgradable mob killing machine that drops experience after every mob. Route mobs from your farm here, I'm sure they'll have a wonderful time!
한국어(Korean).Use your Bottling Machine to fill Empty: Use your Bottling Machine to fill Empty Bottles into Bottles o' Enchanting!
한국어(Korean).Craft an Extra Utilities Enchanter! This: Craft an Extra Utilities Enchanter! This is another crafting mechanic in the mod. You'll need to set up bookshelves around it the same way you do for Enchantment Table, and power it with RF. You can upgrade it with Speed Upgrades and auto insert / extract items into / from it.%n%n§c§lWARNING:§r Due to a bug with Extra Utilities, the Enchanter §cDELETES§r items when inserted via §cSCROLLING§r. Be careful.
한국어(Korean).Craft an Extra Utilities Machine Block!: Craft an Extra Utilities Machine Block! This is the base for all Extra Utilities machines.
한국어(Korean).Surround Lava on all 4 sides with Nether: Surround Lava on all 4 sides with Nether Bricks, then throw in some Gold Ingots to create some Demon Ingots. Alloy it with Lunar Reactive Dust to create Demonlord Ingots!%n%n§6Note:§r There is currently a bug with Extra Utilities that makes it so certain modded Droppers cannot create Demon Ingots. Use either the vanilla or the OpenBlocks Dropper when automating it, or switch to EnderIO's Fire Water once that is available.
한국어(Korean).Use your Enchanter to make some Magical: Use your Enchanter to make some Magical Wood! You might want to continuously keep creating this for later use.
한국어(Korean).Find the Arch Lich's castle in Skythern!: Find the Arch Lich's castle in Skythern! Enter it and go through its maze-like rooms to eventually find a Skythern Key in one of its upper domes!%n%nYou'll need to find and break Diorite-variants in most rooms to continue.
한국어(Korean).Craft some RF Dust! This will only take: Craft some RF Dust! This will only take 1 durability point from your Thermal Conductor Rod.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Thermal Conductor Rod! This item: Craft a Thermal Conductor Rod! This item lets your craft RF Dust which ultimately lets you get into Thermal Expansion.
한국어(Korean).Craft some Mob Masher Bane of Arthropods: Craft some Mob Masher Bane of Arthropods Upgrades. You can insert at most 10 of these in the machine. This will make the Masher deal more damage against Arthropods like Spiders and Silverfish.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Manual Mill! While holding Right: Craft a Manual Mill! While holding Right Click on it, you generate 15 GP (or Grid Power). This is a resource that doesn't need cables. Simply while you're generating X amount of GP, all your GP using machines will work granted you're using at most X amount of GP overall.
한국어(Korean).Craft some Solar Panels! Simply placing: Craft some Solar Panels! Simply placing one down will generate 1 GP in the daytime.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Stone Drum and upgrade it to an: Craft a Stone Drum and upgrade it to an Iron Drum! It can hold 256 Buckets of any liquid, and you can Right Click on it to see how much is left. I would encourage you to set one up to feed Lava into your Smeltery.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Reinforced Large Drum! It can ho: Craft a Reinforced Large Drum! It can hold 4096 Buckets of any liquid! Wow!
한국어(Korean).Craft an Extra Utilities Crusher! This i: Craft an Extra Utilities Crusher! This is yet another way to turn your Ores and Ingots into Dust! It can be sped up by Extra Utilities Speed Upgrades to make it faster than the Immersive Engineering and Mekanism Crushers.
한국어(Korean).Craft some Lunar Panels to be able to ge: Craft some Lunar Panels to be able to generate GP passively during the night!
한국어(Korean).Craft a Lava Mill! This machine generate: Craft a Lava Mill! This machine generates GP when adjacent to flowing lava, based on the highest level of lava. Having Lava on multiple sides doesn't increase the generation. Lava placed one block away from a source block generates the most GP. Note that due to how Lava flows in the Nether, slightly more GP can be gained there.
한국어(Korean).Craft some Mob Masher Beheading Upgrades: Craft some Mob Masher Beheading Upgrades. You can insert at most 10 of these in the machine. This will make the Masher drop mobs Skulls way more frequently than they would normally drop. Only vanilla Skulls are available though.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Water Mill! This machine generat: Craft a Water Mill! This machine generates GP passively when there is flowing water on any of its sides.%n%nThis generator has been nerfed, and generates significantly less power due to scaling off much faster than normal.
한국어(Korean).Craft an OpenBlocks Fan! When powered by: Craft an OpenBlocks Fan! When powered by redstone, it blows any entity away. Useful for a mob farm, although the Mob Fan is even better.
한국어(Korean).Drops of Evil are no longer dropped by W: Drops of Evil are no longer dropped by Wither Skeletons, they're instead crafted. So craft one! And use it to turn surrounding Grass into Cursed Earth! This type of soil makes mobs spawn constantly, so it's perfect for a mob farm. Just watch out, don't let it burn.%n%n§6Note:§r Only the block that the Drop of Evil was used on can be harvested with Silk Touch.
한국어(Korean).Craft an Auto Anvil! You can automatical: Craft an Auto Anvil! You can automatically insert tools & armor to repair them using liquid experience.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Mob Fan Height Modifier! You can: Craft a Mob Fan Height Modifier! You can apply at most 3 of these to your Mob Fan.
한국어(Korean).Upgrade your OpenBlocks Fan into a Mob F: Upgrade your OpenBlocks Fan into a Mob Fan! When powered by redstone, this machine blows mobs with great strength, and it's the perfect way to move mobs off your spawning platform. Additionally, it's highly upgradable, and with max upgrades you'll surely only need at most one per platform.
한국어(Korean).Craft some Mob Fan Distance Modifiers! Y: Craft some Mob Fan Distance Modifiers! You can apply at most 10 of these to your Mob Fan.
한국어(Korean).Craft some Mob Masher Sharpness Upgrades: Craft some Mob Masher Sharpness Upgrades. You can insert at most 10 of these in the machine. This will make the Masher generally deal more damage to all things.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Transfer Pipe and one of each ty: Craft a Transfer Pipe and one of each type of Transfer Node - Item, Fluid, and Energy. Each functions slightly differently.%nOne big advantage is that you can route items, fluids, and energy all through one pipe - although filtering on the receiving end may be required!%n%n§cThe Item Transfer Node is a highly upgradeable and filterable item routing mechanism, and its much better than Thermal's Itemducts when fully upgraded. It can be upgraded using Extra Utilities' Speed and Stack Upgrades, along with its Filters.%n%n§3The Fluid Transfer Node functions very similarly to the Item Transfer Node (but, you know, with fluids?).%n%n§6The Energy Transfer Node cannot be upgraded, and always transfers 5,000 RF/t.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Building Guide! This block can h: Craft a Building Guide! This block can help you build nice geometric shapes. Use the arrows on top to swap between different shapes. Use the plus and minus signs on the sides to increase or decrease the side of your build. Then power it with a redstone signal to make ghost blocks appear.%n%nYou can also upgrade it into an Enhanced Building Guide to get some more available shapes.
한국어(Korean).Make a Wind Mill! This machine passively: Make a Wind Mill! This machine passively generates GP if there is nothing blocking its northern and southern sides. It generates more in the rain.%n%nThis generator has been buffed and generates 4x the normal amount.
한국어(Korean).Craft some Mob Fan Width Modifiers! Thes: Craft some Mob Fan Width Modifiers! These are likely the most useful upgrades, and you can apply at most 3 of these to your Mob Fan.
한국어(Korean).Yet another Furnace, eh? Well, this one: Yet another Furnace, eh? Well, this one can be pretty speedy with Extra Utilities Speed Upgrades!
한국어(Korean).Craft at least one Ultimate Speed Upgrad: Craft at least one Ultimate Speed Upgrade. This makes machines even faster, and it can stack up to 64. You might need that speed for something in the lategame, but be aware that it'll use a lot of GP.
한국어(Korean).Craft at least one Magical Speed Upgrade: Craft at least one Magical Speed Upgrade! This makes machines even faster, and it can stack up to 16 instead of just 4. However, be aware that your machines will use even more GP when upgraded with higher-tier Speed Upgrades.
한국어(Korean).Craft a couple Speed Upgrades, and one S: Craft a couple Speed Upgrades, and one Stack & Mining Upgrade.%n%n- Speed Upgrades increase a machine's speed or a Transfer Node's transfer rate.%n- One Stack Upgrade makes it so the Transfer Node sends a stack of items at once, instead of individual ones.%n- The Mining Upgrade is similar to the 1.7 World Interaction Upgrade. It mines Cobblestone when placed inside a Transfer Node which is over a full block with Water and Lava source blocks on the side.
한국어(Korean).Craft a couple Upgrade Bases! These can: Craft a couple Upgrade Bases! These can be crafted into Speed, Stack, and Mining Upgrades.
한국어(Korean).Craft some Ineffable and Dark Ineffable: Craft some Ineffable and Dark Ineffable Glass. While players can, mobs can't travel through these blocks, which makes them useful for mob farm or mob spawner walls, as well as general base doors. The regular one does let light through, the dark one doesn't. So mobs will be able to spawn inside when you use the dark variants.
한국어(Korean).Craft some Mob Masher Fire Aspect Upgrad: Craft some Mob Masher Fire Aspect Upgrades. You can insert at most 10 of these in the machine. This will set all mobs on fire that are touched by the Masher. Perfect for Cooked Porkchops!
한국어(Korean).These fellahs deal a lot of damage...! S: These fellahs deal a lot of damage...! So why not craft some?
한국어(Korean).Craft a Fire Mill! This machine generate: Craft a Fire Mill! This machine generates GP passively while over an active Fire block. Use Netherrack below.%n%nThis generator has been buffed and it generates 4x the normal amount.
한국어(Korean).Craft a couple Absorption Range Upgrades: Craft a couple Absorption Range Upgrades to increase the range of your Absorption Hopper! You can use at most 6 of these.
Craft some Mob Masher Looting Upgrades. You can insert at most 10 of these in the machine. This will make the Masher drop more loot.
한국어(Korean).Use Cinnabar Ore with Liquid Cryotheum i: Use Cinnabar Ore with Liquid Cryotheum in the Fluid Transposer to get a bunch of Cinnabar!
한국어(Korean).Craft all 4 types of Thermal Expansion D: Craft all 4 types of Thermal Expansion Dusts!%n%n- To obtain Blizz Powder for Cryotheum, use your Fluid Transposer with Snowballs and Liquid XP.%n%n- To obtain Blitz Powder for Aerotheum, use your Fluid Transposer with Niter and Liquid XP. To get Niter, simply Pulverize Sandstone.%n%n- To get Basalz Powder for Petrotheum, use your Fluid Transposer with Pulverized Obsidian and Liquid XP.
한국어(Korean).Use Mithril Ingots to create Operator Pr: Use Mithril Ingots to create Operator Processors! These are used in Fluid Storage related AE2 items.
한국어(Korean).Use your Arc Furnace or Alloy Smelter to: Use your Arc Furnace or Alloy Smelter to craft some Mithril Ingots! It takes 1 Mana Dust, 1 Demonlord Ingot and 1 Platinum Ingot to craft one.
한국어(Korean).Craft a regular Energy Cell Frame and ma: Craft a regular Energy Cell Frame and make it into an Energy Cell! You can upgrade them with Upgrade Kits, but it might be easier to craft them directly.
한국어(Korean).Create Refined Fuel using your Fractiona: Create Refined Fuel using your Fractionating Still, then Fluid Transpose it onto some Dark Ingots to create Energized Dark Ingots!
한국어(Korean).Craft some Dark Ingots! You can find Bit: Craft some Dark Ingots! You can find Bitumen underground. To obtain Tar, you can either:%n%n- Use a Fractionating Still with Oil (found underground), Crude Oil (obtained from Bitumen) or Liquifacted Coal (obtained from Pulverized Coal); or%n%n- Use DivineRPG Tar and Slimeballs in a Fluid Transposer.
한국어(Korean).Upgrade an Extra Utilities Machine Block: Upgrade an Extra Utilities Machine Block to a Thermal Expansion one!%n%nApply your various wrenches and similar tools to the rewarded Omniwand to easily swap between them.
한국어(Korean).Use some Coated Clathrate to create some: Use some Coated Clathrate to create some Estimation Processors!
한국어(Korean).Craft some Coated Clathrate either in th: Craft some Coated Clathrate either in the Induction Smelter or the Fluid Transposer!%n%nYou need to have visited the End for Resonant Clathrate.
한국어(Korean).Use Cinnabar and Nickel Ore in your Indu: Use Cinnabar and Nickel Ore in your Induction Smelter to get Platinum with 100%% chance!
한국어(Korean).Craft an Induction Smelter! With this ma: Craft an Induction Smelter! With this machine, you can create alloys that only take 2 inputs. For these types (like Bronze, Electrum, Invar, or Vibrant Alloy), the Induction Smelter will do a great job, as it's really fast when fully upgraded.
한국어(Korean).Craft some Rosin in a Fractionating Stil: Craft some Rosin in a Fractionating Still! To get Resin, use either an Arboreal Extractor (recommended, since it's free and will generate passively), or a Sawmill with a Resin Funnel Augment.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Resin Funnel Augment! Apply it t: Craft a Resin Funnel Augment! Apply it to your Sawmill to be able to create Resin. Check which Wood types give Resin in JEI (simply check the usages for this Augment), since that's the type of fluid you'll need in the future.
한국어(Korean).Craft an Arboreal Extractor! To use it,: Craft an Arboreal Extractor! To use it, place it next to the bottom of a naturally grown tree. Different tree types will provide different types of fluids, you are looking for Resin. To see which tree type gives which fluid, you can check the usages for the "Augment: Resin Funnel" item, since the same types of trees yield Resin in a Sawmill. However, I recommend this method for obtaining large amounts of Resin, since this is free and will passively generate.%n%nAdditionally, if you insert any type of Phyto-Gro into the left slot of the machine, you'll get double / triple / quadruple output from your Extractor.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Farming Station! Place it in the: Craft a Farming Station! Place it in the center of a crop field, give it power and a hoe, set its output, and watch it work! Auto crop farms, hurray!
한국어(Korean).Soulificate your Machine Chassis to gain: Soulificate your Machine Chassis to gain access to more machines from EnderIO!
한국어(Korean).Craft a Compactor! This is the best way: Craft a Compactor! This is the best way to automatically make all the various types of Plates and Gears.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Device Frame! This is used in al: Craft a Device Frame! This is used in all the Thermal Expansion Devices (surprise-surprise), which are Machines that usually don't need any power to function.
한국어(Korean).Combine Hardened Fluxducts and Itemducts: Combine Hardened Fluxducts and Itemducts to obtain some Signalum-Plated Itemducts. These pipes can transmit both power and items at the same time. You'll need to use Servos if you want to transmit items.
한국어(Korean).Craft some of the most basic Fluxducts T: Craft some of the most basic Fluxducts Thermal Expansion has to offer: The Leadstone Fluxducts! They can transmit RF Power, but not a lot of it.
한국어(Korean).Craft together RF Powder, Pyrotheum Dust: Craft together RF Powder, Pyrotheum Dust, Cryotheum Dust, Aerotheum Dust & Petrotheum Dust to obtain some Mana Dust!
한국어(Korean).You haven't crafted enough Machine Frame: You haven't crafted enough Machine Frames yet, so for that reason, craft another. Lovely, isn't it!?
한국어(Korean).Craft a Basic Alloy Smelter! This is a c: Craft a Basic Alloy Smelter! This is a cheaper version of the Arc Furnace in multiple cases, but it can only handle 3 inputs. But hey, 3 is more than what the Induction Smelter could handle!
한국어(Korean).Craft all 4 upgrade kits! Use them to up: Craft all 4 upgrade kits! Use them to upgrade a Basic machine to Resonant tier by Right Clicking on it! The advantage of upgrading the machine tier is that you can apply more Augments to the machine. While a Basic machine can only take one Augment, Hardened, Reinforced, Signalum, and Resonant machines can take three, five, seven, and nine Augments respectively. The most useful Augment is likely the Auxiliary Reception Coil, which speeds up the machine.
한국어(Korean).Upgrade your Fluid Conduits into Ender F: Upgrade your Fluid Conduits into Ender Fluid Conduits! These are one of the best types of Fluid Conduits available.
한국어(Korean).Craft some Fluid Conduits! Though not th: Craft some Fluid Conduits! Though not the best without upgrading them to the next tier, they can still be used in the same blockspace as Item & Energy Conduits.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Pulverizer! It's probably the be: Craft a Pulverizer! It's probably the best crushing machine you'll get, especially when fully upgraded to Resonant tier, and provided with 9 Auxiliary Reception Coil upgrades.%n%nYou can also easily setup its side configurations to input and output items from/to your storage.
한국어(Korean).Enticing pricing you have there... It's: Enticing pricing you have there... It's an Icing to the cake! Consider Slice'n'Splicing? If so, craft a Slice'n'Splice! Give it an Axe and some Shears (a good option is the Dark Steel variant for both), and sacrifice some mob skulls to craft some items with it! If you haven't made a Beheading Upgrade from Mob Grinding Utils yet, now would be a great time!
한국어(Korean).Upgrade your Fluxducts all the way to th: Upgrade your Fluxducts all the way to the Resonant variant! This type of Fluxduct can transmit a lot of power!
한국어(Korean).Craft a Red Heart Canister! Your player: Craft a Red Heart Canister! Your player can equip at most 10 of these and get 1 extra full Heart of health per Canister!
한국어(Korean).Craft a Fluid Transposer! When used in c: Craft a Fluid Transposer! When used in conjunction with a Magma Crucible, you can use some kind of an input item and some kind of fluid provided by the Crucible to craft new items. This machine will be heavily used from now on, so make sure to at least semi-automate it. You can also craft Treated Wood and Coated Clathrate cheaper with this machine.%n%nSome recipes, particularly potion recipes, may not appear correctly in JEI. These recipes still function as you would expect, the issue is purely visual.
한국어(Korean).Craft some Hardened Fluiducts to be able: Craft some Hardened Fluiducts to be able to transport Fluids easily!
한국어(Korean).Craft some Signalum-Plated Impulse Itemd: Craft some Signalum-Plated Impulse Itemducts by filling up the previous tier with Glowstone! Items travel more rapidly through Glowstone and you can still transmit power through this cable as well.
한국어(Korean).Craft an Enhanced SAG Mill for even more: Craft an Enhanced SAG Mill for even more crushing power!
한국어(Korean).I heard you like Machine Chassis', so I: I heard you like Machine Chassis', so I put some Machine Chassis' in your Machine Chassis' so you can enjoy more Machine Chassis' along the way!
한국어(Korean).Craft a Sawmill! This machine is capable: Craft a Sawmill! This machine is capable of turning Wood into more Planks than simply crafting them in your Crafting Window, and is also capable of making Sawdust, used in some recipes.
한국어(Korean).Craft four of all 5 tiers of Empowered D: Craft four of all 5 tiers of Empowered Dark Steel Upgrades! They can be applied to Dark Steel Armor one after another. These are needed for other upgrades and to make your armor set take energy instead of durability on hit.%n%nTo apply these upgrades, you need to use a Dark Steel Anvil. Simply have the armor piece equipped and use the tabs in the GUI of the Anvil to be able to apply them.%n%n§6Note:§r The 5th Empowered Tier is only applicable for End Steel and Stellar Armor.%n%n§6Note 2:§r This quest actually has 2 Tasks, you can either complete it by submitting the deactivated OR the activated Dark Steel Upgrades.
한국어(Korean).Once you've accumulated a lot of Dark St: Once you've accumulated a lot of Dark Steel and Enderium, you can make the best midgame armor set: The Dark Steel Set!%n%nNow, without upgrades you might not think this set is that powerful, but just type "Dark Steel Upgrade" into JEI to see the sheer amount of upgrade options available. Pretty much all of them are useful, so get on with the crafting!%n%nAlso, don't forget that this armor is still enchantable besides being upgradable.
한국어(Korean).Craft an 1k ME Fluid Storage Component!: Craft an 1k ME Fluid Storage Component! Making this into a Cell will allow you to store liquids in your ME System. You can access these with a Fluid Terminal.
한국어(Korean).Craft an Enchanter! To see the available: Craft an Enchanter! To see the available recipes, click the Paper icon on the top right of its GUI. You can now get any Enchantment with the appropriate payment! No longer do you need to get lucky in the Enchantment Table.
한국어(Korean).Craft a 4k ME Fluid Storage Component!: Craft a 4k ME Fluid Storage Component!
한국어(Korean).Dig down to the bottom of the overworld: Dig down to the bottom of the overworld and light up some of the Bedrock! Once the fire extinguishes, some Grains of Infinity will pop off. Collect them!%n%nI wonder if you'll have to automate this process... Hmmm... (Yes, yes you do.)%n%nThen use the grains you've obtained to craft a Simple Machine Chassis from EnderIO!
한국어(Korean).Craft some Item Conduits! They are the E: Craft some Item Conduits! They are the EnderIO way to transport items, and probably one of the best ways in general, since they can be used in the same blockspace as other EnderIO Conduits. You can also use Extraction Speed Upgrades and Item Filters in them. You can also simply toggle Round Robin mode on to distribute items equally between outputs and turn Self Feed mode on to be able to push items back into the container you were pulling them from.
한국어(Korean).Craft a 64k ME Fluid Storage Component!: Craft a 64k ME Fluid Storage Component!
한국어(Korean).Craft a 16k ME Fluid Storage Component!: Craft a 16k ME Fluid Storage Component!
한국어(Korean).Craft a Basic Item Filter then upgrade i: Craft a Basic Item Filter then upgrade it to an Advanced Item Filter. Apply them to your Item Conduits and guess what they do...!%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%n%nNo, I'm not gonna tell you. You really have to guess.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Soul Binder! Use Soul Vials with: Craft a Soul Binder! Use Soul Vials with mob souls inside and other input items to infuse the soul into the item! Spooky!
Craft a Soul Vial! Use it to catch mobs. You can later use them for crafting with the Soul Binder, or soon enough - to automatically spawn more of them... See Chapter 13: Ender Upgrades.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Redstone Furnace! It's a pretty: Craft a Redstone Furnace! It's a pretty great smelting machine, especially when fully upgraded to Resonant tier, and provided with 9 Auxiliary Reception Coil upgrades.%n%nYou can also easily set up its side configurations to input and output items from/to your storage.
한국어(Korean).Instead of crafting Fluid Storage Cells,: Instead of crafting Fluid Storage Cells, you can choose to store your Fluids in external tanks or drums that might have a larger capacity. For this purpose, you can use an ME Fluid Storage Bus.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Magma Crucible! This machine can: Craft a Magma Crucible! This machine can turn many solid items into its liquid form. You'll mostly need to use it to provide various liquids for the Fluid Transposer.
한국어(Korean).Craft all 3 tiers of regular EnderIO Cap: Craft all 3 tiers of regular EnderIO Capacitors! They can be used in all non-basic EnderIO machines to increase their production speed. Even higher tier Capacitors will be available later.
한국어(Korean).You thought the Alloy Smelter was gonna: You thought the Alloy Smelter was gonna be that slow?! Well, no longer! Introducing: The Enhanced Alloy Smelter, which is more than twice as fast.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Fluid Terminal! Through this you: Craft a Fluid Terminal! Through this you can see all stored Fluids in your ME System, and manually import and export a couple of buckets at once. Though I recommend Fluid Export and Import Buses for this job, especially if you're working with larger amounts.
한국어(Korean).Smelt some Dark Steel in your Basic Allo: Smelt some Dark Steel in your Basic Alloy Smelter to be able to craft an actual Alloy Smelter! This machine can be upgraded with Capacitors for faster production.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Glacial Precipitator! With this: Craft a Glacial Precipitator! With this machine, you can automatically create Snow, Ice, or Packed Ice out of Water! Simply feed it Water with an Aqueous Accumulator, an Unending Bowl, or an Endervoir, give it some power and watch it work!
한국어(Korean).Craft a Basic Capacitor Bank. It can sto: Craft a Basic Capacitor Bank. It can store some power, but you likely want to upgrade it further!
한국어(Korean).Craft an Aqueous Accumulator! Place at l: Craft an Aqueous Accumulator! Place at least 2 Water Source blocks next to it. This is a fast way to generate a lot of Water for a couple of your machines.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Fractionating Still! This machin: Craft a Fractionating Still! This machine is used for multiple progression-related crafts. It can turn various liquids into solids and other liquids. It can also be used with an Alchemical Retort Augment to increase the level of potions beyond II.%n%n§6§lNote:§r The JEI recipes for filling potions may not appear correctly, but still works.
한국어(Korean).Craft an Experience Obelisk! You can pum: Craft an Experience Obelisk! You can pump Liquid XP in and out from it, or simply use the ingame GUI to store or gain XP with some simple button presses.
한국어(Korean).Craft some Extract Speed Upgrades. You c: Craft some Extract Speed Upgrades. You can apply these to your Item Conduits for faster extraction. (Incredible, I know!)
한국어(Korean).I laid out the most important Dark Steel: I laid out the most important Dark Steel Upgrades: the ones that make this armor set pretty powerful. Craft them and apply them in a Dark Steel Anvil!%n%n§6Note:§r This quest actually has 2 Tasks, you can either complete it by submitting the deactivated OR the activated Dark Steel Upgrades.
한국어(Korean).Craft an Enhanced Vat! You'll need many: Craft an Enhanced Vat! You'll need many of the EnderIO Liquids crafted by this machine to continue in the following chapters.
한국어(Korean).Craft an Igneous Extruder! Using this ma: Craft an Igneous Extruder! Using this machine you can mix Lava and Water to create various stones like Cobblestone, Obsidian, Basalt, or many of the Underground Biomes Stone variants! Simply feed it Lava and Water and watch it work! Note: For Obsidian, Lava does get consumed. For the others, it doesn't.
한국어(Korean).Craft some Ender Energy Conduits! These: Craft some Ender Energy Conduits! These are the highest tier Energy Conduits that are available to you currently, and the best ones for the job! Later you'll be able to make even better Energy Conduits from EnderIO Endergy.
한국어(Korean).Craft some Energy Conduits! Use them as: Craft some Energy Conduits! Use them as an upgrade base for higher tier EnderIO Energy Conduits.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Redprint! You can use it to copy: Craft a Redprint! You can use it to copy a machine's side configurations to a new machine. When placing a machine with it in your offhand, it will auto-apply its configuration. It also works on Servos, Retrievers, and Filters. It can save you a lot of time.
한국어(Korean).Make an ME Crafting Terminal! Upgrade yo: Make an ME Crafting Terminal! Upgrade your old ME Terminal to be able to directly craft using your items in your ME System!
한국어(Korean).Upgrade your Hardened Fluiducts to Super: Upgrade your Hardened Fluiducts to Super-Laminar Fluiducts for limitless fluid transfer!
한국어(Korean).Craft a SAG Mill! Though the Pulverizer: Craft a SAG Mill! Though the Pulverizer might be the best when fully upgraded, this machine isn't far behind! Later the Enhanced version with higher tier Capacitors can do the job pretty much as good as a fully upgraded Pulverizer.
한국어(Korean).Craft some Capacitor Banks together to o: Craft some Capacitor Banks together to obtain a Vibrant Capacitor Bank! The advantage of using them over any other mod's power storage options, is that you can create a huge multiblock of Capacitor Banks that can store even more power!
한국어(Korean).Craft a Resonant Energy Cell Frame, fill: Craft a Resonant Energy Cell Frame, fill it up, and craft it into a Resonant Energy Cell! To find Energy Cell recipes, look up the usages of the Invar Gear, Electrum Gear, Signalum Gear, (or in this case) the Enderium Gear. It might be easier to craft them directly rather than upgrading them.
한국어(Korean).Craft 9 Auxiliary Reception Coil Augment: Craft 9 Auxiliary Reception Coil Augments. This is the maximum amount you can apply to a Resonant machine!%n%nBasic machines can accept 1,%nHardened machines can accept 3,%nReinforced machines can accept 5,%nSignalum machines can accept 7,%nand Resonant machines can accept 9.
한국어(Korean).Craft an ME Fluid Import Bus and an ME F: Craft an ME Fluid Import Bus and an ME Fluid Export Bus! They work just like their item counterparts, except for Fluids.
한국어(Korean).Crush some organic materials into Biofue: Crush some organic materials into Biofuel, then infuse it with Water and Hydrogen to create some Substrate and Ethylene! You can use more Ethylene to multiply your Substrate.
한국어(Korean).Craft an Electrolytic Separator! Use som: Craft an Electrolytic Separator! Use some kind of a pipe to import Water into the machine, and provide power to it as well. It will separate Water into Hydrogen and Oxygen. To transfer these gases, use Mekanism Pressurized Tubes. To store them, use Mekanism Gas Tanks. You can find quests for them to the right of this one.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Mekanism Pressurized Reaction Ch: Craft a Mekanism Pressurized Reaction Chamber! It takes 1 Fluid input, 1 Gas input and 1 Item input to create other Gases and Items. You'll also need to provide it with power so use all sides wisely!%n%nNote: If you need to clear the input tank, use a Gauge Dropper!
한국어(Korean).Craft a Solar Panel III! It can generate: Craft a Solar Panel III! It can generate 32 RF/tick. Finally a respectable amount.
한국어(Korean).Craft 8 Tier 1 Solar Panels together for: Craft 8 Tier 1 Solar Panels together for a Tier 2 Solar Panel! It generates an even more incredible 8 RF/tick.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Solar Panel VIII! It's capable o: Craft a Solar Panel VIII! It's capable of generating a massive 32,768 RF/tick! It's almost like an Extreme Reactor in a singular block!
한국어(Korean).Craft a Solar Panel VII! It generates 8,: Craft a Solar Panel VII! It generates 8,192 RF/tick. Better than a lot of other generators! :O
한국어(Korean).Craft a Mob Slaughter Factory! Provide i: Craft a Mob Slaughter Factory! Provide it with power, and use it to kill mobs from your Mob Farm or Animal Farm! This machine will produce Liquid Meat and Liquid Pink Slime in the process. Make sure to export both liquids. This can be done from a single side, through a Fluiduct or Fluid Conduit of sorts.
한국어(Korean).Create some Plastic Sheets either by cra: Create some Plastic Sheets either by crafting, or in the Enrichment Chamber (the latter is preferable, as it's much cheaper). Then use 4 Plastic Sheets and half a bucket of Nutrient Distillation (created in the EnderIO Vat) to create 1 Industrial Foregoing Plastic!
한국어(Korean).Craft a Material StoneWork Factory! This: Craft a Material StoneWork Factory! This machine can easily create some various basic materials, and it's the perfect way to automate them. Simply look up its capabilities in JEI, and set up multiple of them for easy automation!
한국어(Korean).Obtain at least 1 Bucket worth of Liquid: Obtain at least 1 Bucket worth of Liquid Pink Slime! Make a small pen and dig out a 1x1 area to place your fluid into. After about a minute, the liquid will transform into a baby Pink Slime. Use looting on the cutie, or name it Jerry and keep it as your pet, or something. Your choice.%n%nIf you chose the first option, continue creating a Pink Slime Ingot.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Shape Card: Pump! With this, you: Craft a Shape Card: Pump! With this, you can use your Builder to drain liquids just like any other Pump would do.
한국어(Korean).Welcome to the age of \"not being low on: Welcome to the age of "not being low on any material" anymore! Craft an RFTools Builder and a Shape Card. You can use this machine to build structures for you, but you can also use it as a Quarry, once you upgrade your Shape Card into a Shape Card: Quarry.%n%n(Note that the Builder's recipe takes 2 Block Breakers and 2 Block Placers.)%n%nFeed it power and place a Chest on top for outputs. Place a lever on the side to activate it (or any other Redstone activation component).%n%nRoute the items from the output chest into your storage system and process the ores automatically with your Pulverizers and Redstone Furnaces.
한국어(Korean).Craft an Amplification Crystal! It is us: Craft an Amplification Crystal! It is used to... amplify stuff...! What did you think it was used for?!
한국어(Korean).Craft 4 QuantumFlux Gold Casings! This i: Craft 4 QuantumFlux Gold Casings! This is the base for all QuantumFlux machines.
한국어(Korean).Craft an Energy Field Provider! Craft mo: Craft an Energy Field Provider! Craft more Energy Field Addons for Industrial Foregoing machines you want to charge wirelessly. Simply Shift+Right Click an Energy Field Addon onto the Provider, then input it into one of the 4 addon slots of any Industrial Foregoing machine that requires charging. The Provider will charge the machines with the rate of 512 RF/tick, and its range is 7x4x7 around the machine, which can be expanded with Range Addons inside the Provider.
한국어(Korean).Craft some Matter Beamers for your RFToo: Craft some Matter Beamers for your RFTools Spawner to work. Link them to the spawner itself with any of the available wrenches. Provide items into your Matter Beamers that send them to your Spawner. The more Beamers, the faster the Spawner functions.
한국어(Korean).Craft an RFTools Spawner! With this, you: Craft an RFTools Spawner! With this, you can automatically spawn some creatures into the world, though you'll need to pay a price. Note: Not all creatures can be spawned with this primitive block. You'll need Spawners from the following Chapters if you want to spawn other mobs. To use this one though, insert a Syringe of the specified mob, then the GUI will show you items that you need for the mob to spawn. If it shows "nullRF", the mob cannot be spawned unfortunately. You'll need to use Matter Beamers to provide the items. To connect the Matter Beamers, use a Crescent Hammer, a Yeta Wrench, or a Smart Wrench.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Dread Lamp! You'll need a full O: Craft a Dread Lamp! You'll need a full OpenBlocks Tank of Tectonic Petrotheum.%n%nThis block prevents passive mobs from spawning in a 64 block cube centered on itself. It WON'T prevent artificial spawning like Mob Spawners.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Basic Gas Tank! It can store 64: Craft a Basic Gas Tank! It can store 64 Buckets of a single type of Gas.
한국어(Korean).Pulverize some Industrial Grade Graphite: Pulverize some Industrial Grade Graphite Ores into Graphite Dust. Then blow up a stack of Graphite Dust to obtain some Hyper Diamonds!
한국어(Korean).Once upon a time, there was a village in: Once upon a time, there was a village in the far west... They were in dire need of outside help, because they've been invaded by forces... Forces that cannot easily be defeated, because they outnumbered them. An expanding country tried to annex their lands and forcefully levy taxes on them. And they had no say in it!%n%nThe village elders came together one night to discuss matters... How could we repel the invasion!? No one knew the answer. Until a wise young man budged in and whispered: "We have something... they don't have. Let's use it."%n%nAnd indeed they did. They were masters of a technique no one far and wide has ever even thought of...! The masters of Ore Creation.%n%nThey used Darkstone and refined Graphite to give back mother nature what hath been taketh away.%n%nThey indeed had mother nature herself on their side. With this knowledge, they waited for troops from the invading country. They waited patiently until one day, knights had arrived from the distance. The sun barely came up, but they were ready nonetheless.%n%nThey asked for Mother Nature because they knew she would listen... And mother nature provided. She created a massive earthquake that shook the knights off their horses! They got so scared they never returned.%n%nThat day would later be called "The Origin of the Oregen" and be celebrated each year thereafter.%n%nCome, embrace the knowledge of the villagers, and create some Graphite Ore to please mother nature!%n%nThe End
한국어(Korean).Craft a Mekanism Electrolytic Core! This: Craft a Mekanism Electrolytic Core! This is used as a crafting component in some machines.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Wyvern Solar Panel! It can gener: Craft a Wyvern Solar Panel! It can generate 65,536 RF/tick. Holy macaroni!
한국어(Korean).Craft an RFTools Machine Frame! This is: Craft an RFTools Machine Frame! This is the base for all RFTools Machines.
한국어(Korean).Make a Tree Fluid Extractor and a Latex: Make a Tree Fluid Extractor and a Latex Processing Unit! Simply tap any type of Tree with the Extractor and send the fluid Latex into the Latex Processing Unit! It'll create Tiny Dry Rubber which you can easily process into Plastic. You'll need to automatically place logs in front of the Tree Fluid Extractor (using something like a Block Placer), since it'll eat up the log eventually. Setup multiple of these machines for faster gain!
한국어(Korean).Use your Rotary Condensentrator to turn: Use your Rotary Condensentrator to turn Ethylene into Liquid Ethylene. Then feed it into your Pressurized Reaction Chamber along with Oxygen to create some HDPE Pellets!
한국어(Korean).Setup a Plant Gatherer to gather Sapling: Setup a Plant Gatherer to gather Saplings and a Plant Sower to plant them! These make up the perfect combination for an automated Tree Farm!
한국어(Korean).Make a Quibit Crystal! Quibit - quibit!: Make a Quibit Crystal! Quibit - quibit!
한국어(Korean).Create some Fertilizer with your Sewage: Create some Fertilizer with your Sewage Composter! You can use it as Bone Meal, Brown Dye, an input for the Plant Fertilizer Machine, or to create some Crystalline Brown Slime Ingots.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Solar Panel V! It can generate a: Craft a Solar Panel V! It can generate a pretty good 512 RF/tick.%n%nWithout progressing further into other Chapters, this is as far as you can get.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Solar Panel IV! It can generate: Craft a Solar Panel IV! It can generate a much more respectable 128 RF/tick.
한국어(Korean).Craft an RF Entangler, an RF Exciter, an: Craft an RF Entangler, an RF Exciter, and 2 Exciter Upgrades! Place down the Entangler and provide power to it! Place some machines in the vicinity and place some RF Exciters on them! The Entangler is capable of powering all machines equipped with an Exciter as long as both of them are loaded! That's right, they can be any distance away! Applying Exciter Upgrades will increase the transfer rate by 100 RF/tick. Default transfer rate is also 100 RF/tick. Simply Shift+Right Click on the Exciter to apply the Upgrades.
한국어(Korean).Craft a quantity of 1 Quantum Disk. This: Craft a quantity of 1 Quantum Disk. This is used as a crafting material later on.
한국어(Korean).Progress further into Ender Utilities, t: Progress further into Ender Utilities, then craft a Matter Transporter from QuantumFlux! This tool is capable of transporting any non-unbreakable block from one location to the other. It's perfect for relocating Mob Spawners!
한국어(Korean).Make all 3 tiers of RFTools Crafters! Ch: Make all 3 tiers of RFTools Crafters! Check back on this quest after each upgrade to see if the machine was detected or not. The RFTools Crafter is the best external crafting machine, and you can easily set some up right now for items you need a lot of. Simply use an Export Bus with the crating ingredients and an Import Bus for the crafted materials. Don't worry, AE2 autocrafting will be here soon!
한국어(Korean).It's the Ultimate Gas Tank! Upgrade your: It's the Ultimate Gas Tank! Upgrade your Basic variant all the way to this! It can store 512 Buckets worth of Gas.
한국어(Korean).Craft an RFTools Syringe! Left click on: Craft an RFTools Syringe! Left click on a specific type of mob multiple times to fill it up! Then you can insert it into the Spawner to automatically spawn a certain type of mob.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Rotary Condensentrator! This mac: Craft a Rotary Condensentrator! This machine is capable of turning Gases into their Liquid variants or vice versa. Connect it to your power line and use Liquid/Gas cables and storage blocks for input/output.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Solar Panel VI! It can generate: Craft a Solar Panel VI! It can generate 2,048 RF/tick! Wow!
한국어(Korean).Set up an automatic Cow or Pig farm with: Set up an automatic Cow or Pig farm with the machines listed on the right!%n%n- Have a pen of some fully grown animals with an Animal Baby Separator on one of the walls. Use an Animal Feeder on this pen.%n%n- The babies will enter another chamber. Use an Animal Grower on this pen. Create an exit from this chamber through another Animal Baby Separator, but this time with an Adult Filter.%n%n- Lastly, set up a third pen where newly grown adult animals will go. 한국어(Korean).Craft a Speed Upgrade I & II from Tesla: Craft a Speed Upgrade I & II from Tesla Core Lib! One of each of these can be applied to Industrial Foregoing machines. To apply II, a I must be inserted.%n%nThe name of these upgrades are a bit misleading - Speed increases the number of operations done per work cycle and Energy decreases the amount of power required per work cycle.

한국어(Korean).Progress into Actually Additions, then c: Progress into Actually Additions, then craft a QuantumFlux Item Magnet! This is one of the best early- to midgame Baubles! It requires no power and it has quite a strong magnetic field.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Mega Torch from Torchmaster! You: Craft a Mega Torch from Torchmaster! You will need a full OpenBlocks Tanks of Energized Glowstone.%n%nThis prevents all natural hostile mob spawns in a 64 block cube centered on itself.%n%nThis torch WON'T prevent mobs spawning from Cursed Earth or other artificial methods like Spawners.
한국어(Korean).Craft a Spores Recreator! Provide it wit: Craft a Spores Recreator! Provide it with any of the two vanilla Mushrooms and Water to create more!

한국어(Korean).Craft a Lava Fabricator! When provided w: Craft a Lava Fabricator! When provided with power, it'll simply create Lava! Though it uses a lot of RF, so pumping some hot stuff from the Nether might still be a better option for you.
한국어(Korean).Upgrade your Pressized Tubes all the way: Upgrade your Pressized Tubes all the way to the Ultimate variant! They can transfer slightly over 4 Buckets of Gas per tick, or over 80 Buckets per second!

한국어(Korean).It's time to use the Empowerer to empowe: It's time to use the Empowerer to empower your Crystals! Place the Crystal you want to empower on the Empowerer, and the other four items on Display Stands:%n%n- for Restonia Crystal: Signalum Gear, Redstone Alloy Ingot, Bricks, Infernal Bulb%n%n- for Palis Crystal: Lead Gear, Prismarine Shard, Moonglow Leaf, Enderium Base%n%n- for Void Crystal: Dark Bimetal Gear, Invar Gear, Flint, Charcoal%n%n- for Enori Crystal: Iron Gear, Steel Gear, Snow, Silicon%n%n- for Glod Crystal: Lumium Gear, Energized Bimetal Gear, Wildewheet, Blaze Rod%n%n- for Diamatine Crystal: Platinum Gear, Vivid Alloy Ingot, Cloud Berry, Clay%n%n- for Emeradic Crystal: Vibrant Bimetal Gear, Congealed Slime Block, Spirit Herb, Cactus.
한국어(Korean).Twice the range. Your whole base will be: Twice the range. Your whole base will be covered!
한국어(Korean).Charges players within 24 blocks in ever: Charges players within 24 blocks in every direction. Right Click to show its range in-world.%n%nNo, you cannot use it to shock someone else.
한국어(Korean).You can place one of these on each side: You can place one of these on each side of the Enhanced Wireless Charging Antenna, doubling its charging distance in that direction. Cannot be placed on the bottom.
한국어(Korean).The Staff of Traveling allows you to tel: The Staff of Traveling allows you to teleport a couple blocks forward, at the cost of power.%nDo note that you will still suffer from fall damage if you are not careful.%n%nIt can also teleport you up to 200 blocks to a Travel Anchor, so long as the Travel Anchor is loaded.
한국어(Korean).Imbue Soularium with some Dark Steel and: Imbue Soularium with some Dark Steel and a bit of Elevation.%n%nWhat do you mean you can't?%nFine, just use an ingot of Elevatium.
한국어(Korean).Craft an Empowerer and 4 Display Stands!: Craft an Empowerer and 4 Display Stands! The Display Stands you have crafted must be placed exactly 3 blocks away from the Empowerer along the four cardinal directions.%nThe Empowerer is a crafting system that consumes power and specialized items from the display stands in a display of light, empowerering the item atop the Empowerer.
한국어(Korean).Using your Advanced Coil, craft a Single: Using your Advanced Coil, craft a Single Battery and upgrade to a Double Battery!
